Yes, you can operate on the chaninvdatablock column in the bank_and_transactions table to improve data access speed filtering by 'onlineuse'.

The chaninvdatablock column is a JSONB column that packs together digital-channel habits and investment/trading style flags for engagement and cross-sell scoring.

You can use the following SQL query to filter the data by 'onlineuse':

```sql
SELECT *
FROM bank_and_transactions
WHERE chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High';
```

This query uses the `->>` operator to extract the value of the 'onlineuse' key from the JSONB column and compare it to the value 'High'.

To improve data access speed, you can create an index on the chaninvdatablock column:

```sql
CREATE INDEX idx_chaninvdatablock_onlineuse
ON bank_and_transactions
USING GIN (chaninvdatablock);
```

This will create a GIN index on the chaninvdatablock column, which is optimized for JSONB data types.

Note: Creating an index may take some time and resources, depending on the size of your database. Make sure to test the performance impact before applying it to a production environment.
